segments.text: Bridge ahead. You pull up to the toll booth. Coins ready.
But the barrier is a club. And the hand holding it is green. It's a troll booth. What do you do?
Most drivers just throw their coins at him.
Big mistake. Trolls don't want coins. They want more coins.
He shakes your car like a piggy bank. Every coin, every crumb. And then, he keeps the piggy bank.
Here's how you do it properly.
Read the sign. Toll: one riddle. So you ask him one.
What has four wheels, and flies?
He thinks. And thinks. Steam comes out of his ears.
The answer: a bin lorry! He laughs so hard, he drops the club.
Free passage. For you, and for the bin lorry behind you.
Next exam question: the speed bump is a sleeping walrus. Follow, so you don't miss it.
